mentions.name: SogaPaper
mentions.description: This web app helps users get through text-heavy documents faster by translating, summarizing, and answering questions at both the whole-document level and the paragraph level, while preserving the important inner logic and structure of the passage. It is free to start.
mentions.problem: Under the pressure of AI development, people consume more text content than ever—reading papers, industry and company information, and researching newly launched products or techniques—making it a heavy load to consume all this information fast and deep.
mentions.audience: Knowledge workers and college students who need to consume papers and industry information fast and deep.
mentions.source_excerpt:
SogaPaper - https://sogapaper.ai/

People are consuming more and more text content than ever before to get more information, under the pressure of AI development.
For me, I need to read papers, go through information related to my industry and company, sometimes my boss asks me to conduct a research on some newly launched products or techniques revealed by passages.

It's really a heavy load to consume all these information fast and deep, so I built SogaPaper: https://sogapaper.ai
It can translate, summarize, q&a not only at the whole document level, but support paragraph-level quick glances and q&a, preserving the important inner logic and structure of the whole passage, very suitable for knowledge workers and college students nowadays.
